name: Whispering Curse
source: This is the story of a young man who inherits something strange — along with a curse. Searching for answers and a way to break it, he discovers a witch whose shop exists only for supernatural beings and those touched by the paranormal. The witch aids lost souls and desperate wanderers, but to the protagonist she offers an unusual deal: take her place and work a single night in the shop. What kind of visitors will step into the shack before dawn?
